ControlPropertyState.AutoRuleBindingString:
If(
    !IsBlank(varSelectedExpenseDoc.Project) && !IsBlank(varSelectedProjectType) && !IsBlank(varSelectedLegalEntity),
    LookUp(
        'DCSL ProjectTypeProjectValue Entity (mserp)',
        Project = varSelectedExpenseDoc.Project &&
        Company = varSelectedLegalEntity &&
        'Project Type' = varSelectedProjectType
    ),
    Blank()
)

If(
    !IsBlank(varSelectedProjectType) && !IsBlank(varSelectedLegalEntity),
    SortByColumns(
        Filter(
            'DCSL ProjectTypeProjectValue Entity (mserp)',
            'Project Type' = varSelectedProjectType &&
            Company = varSelectedLegalEntity
        ),
        "mserp_projectvalue",
        SortOrder.Ascending
    ),
    []
)

If(
    !IsBlank(varSelectedProjectType) && !IsBlank(varSelectedLegalEntity),
    Filter(
        'DCSL ProjectTypeProjectValue Entity (mserp)',
        'Project Type' = varSelectedProjectType &&
        Company = varSelectedLegalEntity
    ),
    []
)

If(
    ThisItem.FileExtension in ["jpg", "bmp", "jpeg", "png", "heic", "tif", "tiff", "raw"],
    If(
        !IsBlank(ThisItem.CapturedDocument),
        ThisItem.CapturedDocument,
        IconMail
    ),
    ThisItem.FileExtension in ["xlsx", "xls"],
    IconExcel,
    ThisItem.FileExtension in ["docx", "doc"],
    IconWord,
    ThisItem.FileExtension = "pdf",
    IconPDF,
    ThisItem.FileExtension = "txt",
    IconTxt,
    IconMail
)
